NIA files chargesheets in separate cases involving separatist leaders and PFI members

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has filed chargesheets in multiple cases. One involves six separatist leaders, including Shabir Shah, in connection with 1996 Srinagar mob violence. Another case details a plot by PFI members to overthrow the government, with charges framed against 20 individuals. A separate NIA filing also concerns a car blast case in Ambala, alleging a Pakistan-based terrorist recruited individuals.
